RAW_ET_0_MSVD1WMS_JEUHNN_3.title: Will Sensex, Nifty continue to bleed on Monday? 4 factors which will drive D-Street action this week
RAW_ET_0_MSVD1WMS_JEUHNN_3.rawBody: Indian equities are likely to remain range-bound in the week of August 17–21, with elevated crude prices, global uncertainty and shifting US Fed expectations keeping investors cautious. Sensex fell around 500 points and Nifty 205 points last week, while broader markets declined further. Analysts highlight four key factors that could drive Dalal Street’s direction this week, including crude prices, global cues, inflation risks and geopolitical developments.

RAW_ET_1_MSVD1WMS_XDCPZB_4.title: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
RAW_ET_1_MSVD1WMS_XDCPZB_4.rawBody: Madhusudan Kela’s disclosed portfolio of 19 stocks was worth about Rs 2,665 crore as of August 14. Seven holdings gained 10–135% in 2026, while five declined 15–30%, highlighting sharply divergent performances.

RAW_ET_2_MSVD1WMS_16O1GE_5.title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
RAW_ET_2_MSVD1WMS_16O1GE_5.rawBody: The Sensex fell 490 points over five sessions through August 14, while 23 BSE 500 stocks declined daily. Eleven stocks dropped more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah and Techno Electric & Engineering.

RAW_ET_3_MSVD1WMS_BCKOD7_6.title: Adani Enterprises, HDFC Bank among 10 stocks with highest increase in mutual fund holdings in value terms
RAW_ET_3_MSVD1WMS_BCKOD7_6.rawBody: Mutual funds increased holdings in 10 leading Indian companies during the June quarter, with ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank seeing the largest value additions. All 10 stocks gained, led by Adani Enterprises, InterGlobe Aviation and Bajaj Finance during the quarter.

RAW_ET_4_MSVD1WMS_EPZYJV_7.title: Independence Day 2026: 4 stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception. Do you own any?
RAW_ET_4_MSVD1WMS_EPZYJV_7.rawBody: Four companies—Reliance Industries, Hindustan Unilever, ITC and Larsen & Toubro—have been part of the Sensex since inception, reflecting India’s evolving economy. Their journeys span decades of transformation, with vastly different recent performances but enduring relevance in the Indian market.

RAW_ET_5_MSVD1WMS_S8A749_8.title: Three key milestones on the road to financial freedom
RAW_ET_5_MSVD1WMS_S8A749_8.rawBody: Financial freedom is built gradually through understanding, systematic investing and patience. Three milestones—moving from consumption to conviction, investing consistently and creating a financial legacy—can help investors build wealth, stay disciplined through volatility and align money with long-term goals.

RAW_ET_6_MSVD1WMS_NAYH4R_9.title: Independence Day 2026: How Sensex skyrocketed 8,500% in less than 35 years since 1991 liberalisation reforms
RAW_ET_6_MSVD1WMS_NAYH4R_9.rawBody: India’s Sensex has delivered an extraordinary 8,500% gain since the 1991 economic reforms, compounding at about 14% annually. Despite scams, crises and geopolitical shocks, the benchmark has risen across decades.

RAW_ET_7_MSVD1WMS_7RGGK7_A.title: D-Street ends in red for a third week on West Asia deal delay, oil spike
RAW_ET_7_MSVD1WMS_7RGGK7_A.rawBody: The Indian equity market saw a decline on Friday, ending a lackluster trading week as geopolitical tensions and rising crude oil prices loomed over Dalal Street. With the benchmark indices marking their third consecutive week of losses, market apprehensions were evident. Despite this, the results season brought some volatility, with a notable interest from both foreign and domestic institutions amidst the ongoing market fluctuations.

RAW_ET_8_MSVD1WMS_NCGLKE_B.title: Neo Wealth buys a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv
RAW_ET_8_MSVD1WMS_NCGLKE_B.rawBody: Neo Wealth Partners has taken a significant step by acquiring a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv for Rs 230 crore, reinforcing its commitment to the expanding gold loan sector. With the entry of major players like Bain Capital and Tata Capital, Keertana is poised for growth, targeting a portfolio expansion to Rs 6,000 crore by March 2027. The outlook for the Indian gold loan market indicates a promising trajectory ahead.

RAW_ET_9_MSVD1WMS_TRMS36_C.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
RAW_ET_9_MSVD1WMS_TRMS36_C.rawBody: Patanjali Foods posted strong Q1FY27 growth, with revenue rising 29.33% to ₹11,337 crore and operating EBITDA climbing 69.2%. Gross profit increased 35.22%, while the company declared two interim dividends, supported by record revenues and stronger execution across businesses.

RAW_ET_10_MSVD1WMS_ZHX3A0_D.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
RAW_ET_10_MSVD1WMS_ZHX3A0_D.rawBody: Accel India IV has completed the sale of a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company as of August 13, 2026. The Mauritius-based investor offloaded 2 crore equity shares via open market deals, trimming its stake to 4.84 percent. Urban Company stands out with a total equity share capital exceeding 154 crore shares, further emphasizing its scale in the home services market.

RAW_ET_11_MSVD1WMS_XGAFP2_E.title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
RAW_ET_11_MSVD1WMS_XGAFP2_E.rawBody: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% rise in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, while revenue grew 10% to ₹10,750 crore. Record commercial vehicle sales supported performance, though rising material costs pressured margins, prompting cost-saving and pricing initiatives.

RAW_ET_12_MSVD1WMS_QTZNCO_F.title: Sebi proposes to rationalise penalties for settling ongoing cases
RAW_ET_12_MSVD1WMS_QTZNCO_F.rawBody: India's market regulator has introduced an updated framework for addressing securities law violations, designed to streamline processes and decrease litigation. This proposed method may lead to reduced average settlement amounts for infractions. Individuals who faced prior rejections can submit new applications with modified terms. Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

RAW_ET_13_MSVD1WMS_I2Z545_G.title: Sebi mulls digital onboarding for individual foreign investors to boost participation in securities mkt
RAW_ET_13_MSVD1WMS_I2Z545_G.rawBody: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

RAW_ET_14_MSVD1WMS_LXJT8J_H.title: WeWork Global sells 2.5% stake in WeWork India Management for Rs 244 crore
RAW_ET_14_MSVD1WMS_LXJT8J_H.rawBody: WeWork Global has divested a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, bringing its ownership down to 12.3% from 14.82%. Despite this stake reduction, WeWork India reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 4.30 crore for the first quarter while witnessing a total income increase to Rs 700.74 crore during the April-June period. The venture originated as a partnership between WeWork Global and Embassy Group.

29c8257627816c2c7a7a183e1decf3d9.title: Small, microcaps offer better alpha opportunities; midcaps look expensive: Equitree CIO Pawan Bharaddia
29c8257627816c2c7a7a183e1decf3d9.rawBody: Indian equities may stay supported by a resilient domestic economy, but future returns are likely to depend more on earnings growth than valuation re-rating, says Pawan Bharaddia of Equitree Capital Advisors. He sees alpha opportunities in select small and microcaps, especially those with a ₹1,000–5,000 crore market cap, while largecaps offer better stability and earnings visibility.

646d36af09dfe62acc07097c397aafea.title: Zinc Rally: What's drivingprices to record highs and what lies ahead?
646d36af09dfe62acc07097c397aafea.rawBody: Zinc prices have escalated to their highest levels in years on international markets, fueled by supply interruptions and dwindling stockpiles. The robust industrial need, particularly for galvanized steel, is sustaining these elevated prices. Currently, the global zinc market is experiencing a minor shortfall, a trend likely to endure. Looking ahead, growth in demand remains positive, supported by ongoing urbanization and significant infrastructure projects.

62d9aac4b7285fd31c822c87d7c29339.rawBody: US President Donald Trump on Saturday once again renewed his call for the Senate to act quickly to make daylight saving time permanent, saying that changing the clocks twice a year causes unnecessary disruption. RAW_ET_12_MSVDCS37_B22UDV_F.title: Sebi proposes to rationalise penalties for settling ongoing cases
RAW_ET_12_MSVDCS37_B22UDV_F.rawBody: India's market regulator has introduced an updated framework for addressing securities law violations, designed to streamline processes and decrease litigation. This proposed method may lead to reduced average settlement amounts for infractions. Individuals who faced prior rejections can submit new applications with modified terms. Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

RAW_ET_13_MSVDCS37_L7Y8XT_G.title: Sebi mulls digital onboarding for individual foreign investors to boost participation in securities mkt
RAW_ET_13_MSVDCS37_L7Y8XT_G.rawBody: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

RAW_ET_14_MSVDCS37_85GOC8_H.rawBody: WeWork Global has divested a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, bringing its ownership down to 12.3% from 14.82%. 0fbf1a65f260dfd0a945aa6f6b45f42a.rawBody: Crude oil futures experienced an upward trend on Friday due to disruptions from tanker attacks and the stagnation of peace talks. Brent crude closed at $88.52 a barrel while WTI crude settled at $82.40. Attacks within the Strait of Hormuz and disruptions at a Russian port led to a decline in shipping activity. Fortunately, storage levels have proven more resilient, potentially exerting downward pressure on prices.

e122c980853e8bcd485fa9729f6e3184.rawBody: European stock markets closed in the red on Friday, breaking a four-week winning streak. The rise in crude oil prices and escalating geopolitical tensions overshadowed robust corporate earnings. Although the STOXX 600 index experienced a weekly decline, it remained close to record levels, buoyed by strong economic growth and profits across sectors. Investors began reallocating their portfolios, moving away from stocks related to artificial intelligence.

RAW_ET_0_MSVDO0UA_00ZEET_3.title: Will Sensex, Nifty continue to bleed on Monday? 4 factors which will drive D-Street action this week
RAW_ET_0_MSVDO0UA_00ZEET_3.rawBody: Indian equities are likely to remain range-bound in the week of August 17–21, with elevated crude prices, global uncertainty and shifting US Fed expectations keeping investors cautious. Sensex fell around 500 points and Nifty 205 points last week, while broader markets declined further. Analysts highlight four key factors that could drive Dalal Street’s direction this week, including crude prices, global cues, inflation risks and geopolitical developments.

RAW_ET_1_MSVDO0UA_6STQX7_4.rawBody: Madhusudan Kela’s disclosed portfolio of 19 stocks was worth about Rs 2,665 crore as of August 14. Seven holdings gained 10–135% in 2026, while five declined 15–30%, highlighting sharply divergent performances.

RAW_ET_2_MSVDO0UA_XX5W5S_5.title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
RAW_ET_2_MSVDO0UA_XX5W5S_5.rawBody: The Sensex fell 490 points over five sessions through August 14, while 23 BSE 500 stocks declined daily. Eleven stocks dropped more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah and Techno Electric & Engineering.

RAW_ET_3_MSVDO0UA_XXSV6H_6.title: Adani Enterprises, HDFC Bank among 10 stocks with highest increase in mutual fund holdings in value terms
RAW_ET_3_MSVDO0UA_XXSV6H_6.rawBody: Mutual funds increased holdings in 10 leading Indian companies during the June quarter, with ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank seeing the largest value additions. All 10 stocks gained, led by Adani Enterprises, InterGlobe Aviation and Bajaj Finance during the quarter.

RAW_ET_4_MSVDO0UA_TBXU9D_7.title: Independence Day 2026: 4 stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception. Do you own any?
RAW_ET_4_MSVDO0UA_TBXU9D_7.rawBody: Four companies—Reliance Industries, Hindustan Unilever, ITC and Larsen & Toubro—have been part of the Sensex since inception, reflecting India’s evolving economy. Their journeys span decades of transformation, with vastly different recent performances but enduring relevance in the Indian market.

RAW_ET_5_MSVDO0UA_9C7NBU_8.title: Three key milestones on the road to financial freedom
RAW_ET_5_MSVDO0UA_9C7NBU_8.rawBody: Financial freedom is built gradually through understanding, systematic investing and patience. Three milestones—moving from consumption to conviction, investing consistently and creating a financial legacy—can help investors build wealth, stay disciplined through volatility and align money with long-term goals.

RAW_ET_6_MSVDO0UA_NGFQZ8_9.title: Independence Day 2026: How Sensex skyrocketed 8,500% in less than 35 years since 1991 liberalisation reforms
RAW_ET_6_MSVDO0UA_NGFQZ8_9.rawBody: India’s Sensex has delivered an extraordinary 8,500% gain since the 1991 economic reforms, compounding at about 14% annually. Despite scams, crises and geopolitical shocks, the benchmark has risen across decades.

RAW_ET_7_MSVDO0UA_5OKF6J_A.title: D-Street ends in red for a third week on West Asia deal delay, oil spike
RAW_ET_7_MSVDO0UA_5OKF6J_A.rawBody: The Indian equity market saw a decline on Friday, ending a lackluster trading week as geopolitical tensions and rising crude oil prices loomed over Dalal Street. With the benchmark indices marking their third consecutive week of losses, market apprehensions were evident. Despite this, the results season brought some volatility, with a notable interest from both foreign and domestic institutions amidst the ongoing market fluctuations.

RAW_ET_8_MSVDO0UA_Y7F2P4_B.title: Neo Wealth buys a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv
RAW_ET_8_MSVDO0UA_Y7F2P4_B.rawBody: Neo Wealth Partners has taken a significant step by acquiring a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv for Rs 230 crore, reinforcing its commitment to the expanding gold loan sector. With the entry of major players like Bain Capital and Tata Capital, Keertana is poised for growth, targeting a portfolio expansion to Rs 6,000 crore by March 2027. The outlook for the Indian gold loan market indicates a promising trajectory ahead.

RAW_ET_9_MSVDO0UA_NL1M65_C.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
RAW_ET_9_MSVDO0UA_NL1M65_C.rawBody: Patanjali Foods posted strong Q1FY27 growth, with revenue rising 29.33% to ₹11,337 crore and operating EBITDA climbing 69.2%. Gross profit increased 35.22%, while the company declared two interim dividends, supported by record revenues and stronger execution across businesses.

RAW_ET_10_MSVDO0UA_03QJBT_D.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
RAW_ET_10_MSVDO0UA_03QJBT_D.rawBody: Accel India IV has completed the sale of a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company as of August 13, 2026. The Mauritius-based investor offloaded 2 crore equity shares via open market deals, trimming its stake to 4.84 percent. Urban Company stands out with a total equity share capital exceeding 154 crore shares, further emphasizing its scale in the home services market.

RAW_ET_11_MSVDO0UA_4CGX9F_E.title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
RAW_ET_11_MSVDO0UA_4CGX9F_E.rawBody: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% rise in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, while revenue grew 10% to ₹10,750 crore. Record commercial vehicle sales supported performance, though rising material costs pressured margins, prompting cost-saving and pricing initiatives.

RAW_ET_12_MSVDO0UA_AFOX84_F.title: Sebi proposes to rationalise penalties for settling ongoing cases
RAW_ET_12_MSVDO0UA_AFOX84_F.rawBody: India's market regulator has introduced an updated framework for addressing securities law violations, designed to streamline processes and decrease litigation. This proposed method may lead to reduced average settlement amounts for infractions. Individuals who faced prior rejections can submit new applications with modified terms. Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

RAW_ET_13_MSVDO0UA_LG1Q30_G.title: Sebi mulls digital onboarding for individual foreign investors to boost participation in securities mkt
RAW_ET_13_MSVDO0UA_LG1Q30_G.rawBody: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

RAW_ET_14_MSVDO0UA_4V59LQ_H.title: WeWork Global sells 2.5% stake in WeWork India Management for Rs 244 crore
RAW_ET_14_MSVDO0UA_4V59LQ_H.rawBody: WeWork Global has divested a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, bringing its ownership down to 12.3% from 14.82%. Despite this stake reduction, WeWork India reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 4.30 crore for the first quarter while witnessing a total income increase to Rs 700.74 crore during the April-June period. The venture originated as a partnership between WeWork Global and Embassy Group.

RAW_ET_6_MSVDPMPU_JU222U_9.title: Independence Day 2026: How Sensex skyrocketed 8,500% in less than 35 years since 1991 liberalisation reforms

RAW_ET_7_MSVDPMPU_52G4YL_A.title: D-Street ends in red for a third week on West Asia deal delay, oil spike
RAW_ET_7_MSVDPMPU_52G4YL_A.rawBody: The Indian equity market saw a decline on Friday, ending a lackluster trading week as geopolitical tensions and rising crude oil prices loomed over Dalal Street. With the benchmark indices marking their third consecutive week of losses, market apprehensions were evident. Despite this, the results season brought some volatility, with a notable interest from both foreign and domestic institutions amidst the ongoing market fluctuations.

RAW_ET_8_MSVDPMPU_BAWXSL_B.title: Neo Wealth buys a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv
RAW_ET_8_MSVDPMPU_BAWXSL_B.rawBody: Neo Wealth Partners has taken a significant step by acquiring a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv for Rs 230 crore, reinforcing its commitment to the expanding gold loan sector. With the entry of major players like Bain Capital and Tata Capital, Keertana is poised for growth, targeting a portfolio expansion to Rs 6,000 crore by March 2027. The outlook for the Indian gold loan market indicates a promising trajectory ahead.

RAW_ET_9_MSVDPMPU_OQP6QD_C.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
RAW_ET_9_MSVDPMPU_OQP6QD_C.rawBody: Patanjali Foods posted strong Q1FY27 growth, with revenue rising 29.33% to ₹11,337 crore and operating EBITDA climbing 69.2%. Gross profit increased 35.22%, while the company declared two interim dividends, supported by record revenues and stronger execution across businesses.

RAW_ET_10_MSVDPMPU_0L3DMO_D.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
RAW_ET_10_MSVDPMPU_0L3DMO_D.rawBody: Accel India IV has completed the sale of a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company as of August 13, 2026. The Mauritius-based investor offloaded 2 crore equity shares via open market deals, trimming its stake to 4.84 percent. Urban Company stands out with a total equity share capital exceeding 154 crore shares, further emphasizing its scale in the home services market.

RAW_ET_11_MSVDPMPU_1CBO5W_E.title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
RAW_ET_11_MSVDPMPU_1CBO5W_E.rawBody: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% rise in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, while revenue grew 10% to ₹10,750 crore. Record commercial vehicle sales supported performance, though rising material costs pressured margins, prompting cost-saving and pricing initiatives.

RAW_ET_12_MSVDPMPU_78VDZ0_F.title: Sebi proposes to rationalise penalties for settling ongoing cases
RAW_ET_12_MSVDPMPU_78VDZ0_F.rawBody: India's market regulator has introduced an updated framework for addressing securities law violations, designed to streamline processes and decrease litigation. This proposed method may lead to reduced average settlement amounts for infractions. Individuals who faced prior rejections can submit new applications with modified terms. Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

RAW_ET_13_MSVDPMPU_ZYP3G7_G.title: Sebi mulls digital onboarding for individual foreign investors to boost participation in securities mkt
RAW_ET_13_MSVDPMPU_ZYP3G7_G.rawBody: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

RAW_ET_14_MSVDPMPU_NMUJL5_H.title: WeWork Global sells 2.5% stake in WeWork India Management for Rs 244 crore
RAW_ET_14_MSVDPMPU_NMUJL5_H.rawBody: WeWork Global has divested a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, bringing its ownership down to 12.3% from 14.82%. Despite this stake reduction, WeWork India reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 4.30 crore for the first quarter while witnessing a total income increase to Rs 700.74 crore during the April-June period. The venture originated as a partnership between WeWork Global and Embassy Group.

Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

RAW_ET_13_MSVE1FGK_R2Q59E_G.rawBody: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

RAW_ET_7_MSVEMO4V_N86P00_A.rawBody: The Indian equity market saw a decline on Friday, ending a lackluster trading week as geopolitical tensions and rising crude oil prices loomed over Dalal Street. With the benchmark indices marking their third consecutive week of losses, market apprehensions were evident. Despite this, the results season brought some volatility, with a notable interest from both foreign and domestic institutions amidst the ongoing market fluctuations.

RAW_ET_8_MSVEMO4V_LRVW26_B.title: Neo Wealth buys a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv
RAW_ET_8_MSVEMO4V_LRVW26_B.rawBody: Neo Wealth Partners has taken a significant step by acquiring a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv for Rs 230 crore, reinforcing its commitment to the expanding gold loan sector. With the entry of major players like Bain Capital and Tata Capital, Keertana is poised for growth, targeting a portfolio expansion to Rs 6,000 crore by March 2027. The outlook for the Indian gold loan market indicates a promising trajectory ahead.

RAW_ET_9_MSVEMO4V_ISB5Q6_C.rawBody: Patanjali Foods posted strong Q1FY27 growth, with revenue rising 29.33% to ₹11,337 crore and operating EBITDA climbing 69.2%. Gross profit increased 35.22%, while the company declared two interim dividends, supported by record revenues and stronger execution across businesses.

RAW_ET_10_MSVEMO4V_HX97GP_D.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
RAW_ET_10_MSVEMO4V_HX97GP_D.rawBody: Accel India IV has completed the sale of a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company as of August 13, 2026. The Mauritius-based investor offloaded 2 crore equity shares via open market deals, trimming its stake to 4.84 percent. Urban Company stands out with a total equity share capital exceeding 154 crore shares, further emphasizing its scale in the home services market.

RAW_ET_11_MSVEMO4V_O4Y1TQ_E.title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
RAW_ET_11_MSVEMO4V_O4Y1TQ_E.rawBody: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% rise in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, while revenue grew 10% to ₹10,750 crore. Record commercial vehicle sales supported performance, though rising material costs pressured margins, prompting cost-saving and pricing initiatives.

RAW_ET_12_MSVEMO4V_LJGH63_F.title: Sebi proposes to rationalise penalties for settling ongoing cases
RAW_ET_12_MSVEMO4V_LJGH63_F.rawBody: India's market regulator has introduced an updated framework for addressing securities law violations, designed to streamline processes and decrease litigation. This proposed method may lead to reduced average settlement amounts for infractions. Individuals who faced prior rejections can submit new applications with modified terms. Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

RAW_ET_13_MSVEMO4V_SBCSF0_G.title: Sebi mulls digital onboarding for individual foreign investors to boost participation in securities mkt
RAW_ET_13_MSVEMO4V_SBCSF0_G.rawBody: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

RAW_ET_14_MSVEMO4V_65YA4P_H.title: WeWork Global sells 2.5% stake in WeWork India Management for Rs 244 crore
RAW_ET_14_MSVEMO4V_65YA4P_H.rawBody: WeWork Global has divested a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, bringing its ownership down to 12.3% from 14.82%. Despite this stake reduction, WeWork India reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 4.30 crore for the first quarter while witnessing a total income increase to Rs 700.74 crore during the April-June period. The venture originated as a partnership between WeWork Global and Embassy Group.

In line with this interest, ETMarkets examined the investment holdings of renowned investor Madhusudan Kela. According to the latest data for the June 2026 quarter, Kela publicly disclosed holdings in about 19 stocks, with their total estimated value standing at around Rs 2,665 crore as of August 14. The analysis includes only companies where his stake exceeds 1% and may not capture his entire investment portfolio.A closer look shows that 7 stocks in Kela’s portfolio delivered gains ranging from 10% to 135% so far in calendar year 2026. Meanwhile, 5 stocks turned laggards, declining between 15% and 30% during the same period. (Data Source: ACE Equity, Trendlyne).

CY26 has been a strong run for Rashi Peripherals, with the stock surging 133%, from Rs 358 to Rs 834. Investor Madhusudan Kela held a 1.76% stake as of June 2026, worth around Rs 97 crore.

SG Finserve has delivered a solid 61% gain so far in CY26, climbing from Rs 409 to Rs 660. Madhusudan Kela’s 1.44% holding, as of June 2026, is currently valued at approximately Rs 63 crore.

Indiabulls has more than kept pace in CY26, with its stock rising 57%, from Rs 17 to Rs 27. Madhusudan Kela owned a 2.21% stake as of June 2026, valued at nearly Rs 139 crore.

Kopran has posted a steady 27% rise in CY26, with the stock advancing from Rs 150 to Rs 190. Madhusudan Kela’s 1.72% stake was worth around Rs 16 crore as of June 2026.

Sangam (India) has gained 21% in CY26, moving from Rs 495 to Rs 600. Madhusudan Kela held a sizeable 4.86% stake as of June 2026, with the holding valued at approximately Rs 146 crore.

Subam Papers has delivered an 18% gain so far in CY26, rising from Rs 186 to Rs 220. Madhusudan Kela held a 7.02% stake as of June 2026, worth about Rs 42 crore.

Windsor Machines has edged 12% higher in CY26, with the stock moving from Rs 269 to Rs 302. Madhusudan Kela’s 6.40% stake was valued at approximately Rs 197 crore as of June 2026.

Bombay Dyeing has faced pressure in CY26, with the stock declining 14%, from Rs 133 to Rs 114. Madhusudan Kela held a 1.52% stake as of June 2026, currently worth around Rs 36 crore.

Emkay Global Financial Services has slipped 16% in CY26, falling from Rs 285 to Rs 239. Madhusudan Kela’s 1.06% holding was valued at approximately Rs 7 crore as of June 2026.

IRIS RegTech Solutions has seen a 21% decline in CY26, with the stock dropping from Rs 304 to Rs 241. Madhusudan Kela held a 5.21% stake as of June 2026, worth around Rs 26 crore.

Unicommerce eSolutions has lost 28% so far in CY26, with its stock falling from Rs 120 to Rs 86. Madhusudan Kela’s 1.48% stake was valued at approximately Rs 14 crore as of June 2026.

Repro India has been among the weaker performers, with the stock declining 29% in CY26, from Rs 462 to Rs 327. Madhusudan Kela held a 3.31% stake as of June 2026, currently valued at around Rs 16 crore.

Mutual fund holdings in Larsen & Toubro rose by Rs 15,755 crore to Rs 1,13,539 crore as of June 30, 2026, from Rs 97,784 crore on March 31, 2026, while the stock price increased 18.24%.

Mutual fund holdings in Adani Enterprises increased by Rs 15,171 crore to Rs 21,340 crore as of June 30, 2026, from Rs 6,169 crore on March 31, 2026, while the stock gained 72.62%.

Mutual fund holdings in InterGlobe Aviation rose by Rs 13,791 crore to Rs 50,395 crore as of June 30, 2026, from Rs 36,604 crore on March 31, 2026, while the stock price increased 36.13%.

Mutual fund holdings in Kotak Mahindra Bank increased by Rs 12,737 crore to Rs 95,571 crore as of June 30, 2026, from Rs 82,834 crore on March 31, 2026, while the stock gained 10.99%.

Mutual fund holdings in Maruti Suzuki India rose by Rs 10,205 crore to Rs 68,029 crore as of June 30, 2026, from Rs 57,824 crore on March 31, 2026, while the stock price increased 14.70%.

 SubscribeSign InHomeETPrimeMarketsMarket DataMasterclassNewsIndustrySMEPoliticsWealthMFTechAICareersOpinionNRIPanacheMore MenuStocksNewsLive BlogStock Live BlogEarningsPodcastMarket ClassroomDons of Dalal StreetRecosStock Reports PlusNewMy ScreenerCandlestick ScreenerStock ScreenerStock WatchMarket CalendarStock Price QuotesPortfolio X-rayIPOs/FPOsCommoditiesViewsNewsOthersMentha OilPrecious MetalsGold MGoldSilverGold PetalSilver MicroSilver MGold GuineaSpicesCardamomOil & EnergyNatural GasCrude OilCrude Oil MiniBase MetalsAluminiumZinc MiniLead MiniCopperZincNickelAluminium MiniLeadPlantationKapasCottonUS StocksWall St GuideNewsForexForex NewsCurrency ConverterBondsInvestment IdeasCryptoCrypto NewsCrypto TVCrypto PricesLive Stream!Mind Over MoneyMoreOptionsExpert ViewsAIF PMSDigital Real EstateRealty NewsTechnicalsTechnical ChartVisualizeScreenerWeb StoriesMarkets DataThe Golden Thumb RuleUnlisted CompaniesMarket MogulsWebinarsSitemapDefinitionsBusiness News›Markets›Stocks›News Independence Day 2026: 4 stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception. Do you own any?Written by Debaroti Adhikary, ETMarkets.com|Aug 15, 2026, 11:32:13 AM IST1/5Legacy StocksFrom its humble beginnings in the 1800s, when five stockbrokers gathered under the sprawling canopy of a banyan tree outside Mumbai’s Town Hall, the Indian stock market has evolved into one of the world's most dynamic financial ecosystems.

What started as informal street trading eventually found a permanent home on Dalal Street as the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in 1875—Asia’s oldest stock exchange. Today, that shade under a tree has transformed into fully automated, lightning-fast digital exchange.

The Indian stock market has shown remarkable growth since its inception, with Sensex rallying to 86,000 last year. As India celebrates its 80th Independence Day, here are four stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception.

Reliance Industries went public through its initial public offering (IPO) in October 1977, when it issued 2.8 million equity shares of Rs 10 each. The company is currently India’s most valuable company, with a market capitalisation of around Rs 17.73 lakh crore. The shares of the company dropped 17% in 2026 so far. In the longer term, the stock gained 2% in three years and 22% in five years.

In 1888, visitors to the Kolkata harbour noticed crates full of Sunlight soap bars, embossed with the words "Made in England by Lever Brothers". Soon after followed Lifebuoy in 1895 and other famous brands like Pears, LUX and Vim. Vanaspati was launched in 1918 and the Dalda brand came to the market in 1937. In 1956, Hindustan Unilever (HUL) merged its key Indian entities and launched its IPO, being the first among the foreign subsidiaries to do so. HUL shares have fallen around 11% in 2026 so far. In the longer term, the stock dropped 18% in three years and 14% in five years.

ITC was established in 1910 under the name Imperial Tobacco Company of India Limited. As the Company's ownership progressively Indianised, the name of the Company was changed to India Tobacco Company Limited in 1970 and then to ITC Limited in 1974. The stock has overall fallen 23% in 2026 so far.

Two young and ambitious Danish engineers, Henning Holck-Larsen and Søren Kristian Toubro, founded Larsen & Toubro in 1938. They first started by importing machinery from Europe for onward sales in India. Today, it is an Indian multinational engaged in EPC projects, hi-tech manufacturing and services. The stock has fallen over 2% in 2026, but gained 52% in three years and 143% in five years.

(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

Benchmark index Sensex has rallied a whopping 8,500% in less than 35 years since the big bang economic reforms changed the trajectory of the country. #sr_widget.onDemand p, #stock_pro.onDemand p{font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.28;} .onDemand .live_stock{left:17px;padding:1px 3px 1px 5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:18px;top:9px} #sr_widget.onDemand .sr_desc{margin:0 auto 0;} #sr_widget.onDemand .sr_desc{color: #024d99;margin-top:10px;} #sr_widget.onDemand .crypto .live_stock .lb-icon{8px 6px 5px 3px !important} #sr_widget.crypto.onDemand a.text{border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;padding-bottom:5px;display:block;width:100%} #sr_widget.onDemand .sr_desc .text p, #stock_pro.onDemand .sr_desc .text p{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;} Sensex was launched in January, 1986, soon after which India faced a massive balance of payment crisis that almost pushed the country on the edge of bankruptcy.
